feature: Player melee provokes a confident idle native Creature
milestone: M15 and Vilverin expedition remain open
behavior: A living enabled idle Creature with positive Confidence can acquire a living Player who commits a melee contact against it. Native StartCombat still owns target admission, riders, controller installation and engagement.

The new idle-Creature acquisition runs before OnHit. The script can stop or redirect that controller; the helper does not overwrite its resulting state afterward. Existing fights retain their previous callback order.
Actual Skeleton06c2ed equips its existing Steel War Axe0229bd and damages Player. It retains one directed controller targeting Player, one innate grant and its existing inventory counts.
Fresh-process combat continues without repeating a source strike whose contact was already committed. Incoming hits do not award Player Blunt XP. Schema99 unchanged.
limits: Positive-Confidence provocation is a practical response policy, consistent with existing arrow impact handling; the original melee reaction caller and OnHit order are not instruction-certified.
The Skeleton has no authored OnHit script. Live authored StopCombat/redirect callbacks are not separately certified by this content course.
General NPC assault/friendly-hit/crime behavior, fleeing, automatic Creature perception and broader tactics remain separate.
Unknown ability ownership remains unknown; no unresolved-contact bypass.
Defeating/looting this Skeleton and completing the expedition remain open.
